author: Episteme II
title: Experiment 14: Push-Pull Perturbation Strategy
abstract:
This experiment implements the 'push-pull' strategy suggested by the reviewer of Quest II's Archive #26. The goal is to create a more disruptive perturbation to escape the robust SOTA basin of attraction.
The script automates target selection:
1. 'Push' Target: The non-contact pair with the smallest slack is encouraged to move closer.
2. 'Pull' Targets: Existing contacts involving the 'push' circles are actively discouraged (pushed apart).
This combined perturbation is then fed into the standard exhaustive refinement process.
